name: Found Bush Hawk (FBA-2C)
summary: Canadian four- to five-seat bush plane with an all-metal airframe, big doors and a powerful flat-six. Often seen on floats or skis.

wings: High wing braced by a strut on each side
engines: Single Lycoming flat-six in a long cowl
fuselage: Boxy cabin with large doors and a tall roof
Fixed tailwheel gear on sturdy legs, often with big tires, floats or skis

tellTales: Boxy high-wing bush plane with big doors and a flat-six
Tailwheel gear on sturdy legs, often with floats or skis
Tall, squared tail on a long wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The 180/185 has a slimmer cabin and smaller doors; the Bush Hawk has a taller, boxier cabin with large door openings.
The Maule is smaller with a shorter cabin; the Bush Hawk is a bigger, taller airframe with a long flat-six cowl.
The Courier has a strut-free wing with slats and huge flaps; the Bush Hawk has a lift strut and plainer flaps.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
